summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K confirming the amount of Interest on Capital (IoC) declared on May 15, 2026. The gross amount per share is R$0.18775779427, net after 17.5% withholding tax R$0.15490018027. The filing states no share acquisitions, divestitures, or cancellations were made under the buyback program, and the IoC remains unchanged. Payment is due by April 30, 2027. This is a routine capital distribution notice with no special-situation event. No deal terms apply.
